question: A solid cylinder has a height of 12 cm and a radius of r cm. A part of the cylinder is melted and molded into two cones. One cone has a radius of 3 cm and a height of 4 cm, while the other cone has a radius of 6 cm and a height of 8 cm. If the ratio of the curved surface area of the original cylinder to the sum of the curved surface areas of the two cones is 4 : 1, find the value of 2r.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

CSA (cylinder) = 2πrh = 24πr

For cones, find slant heights:

l₁ = √(3² + 4²) = 5, l₂ = √(6² + 8²) = 10

CSA (cones) = πr₁l₁ + πr₂l₂ = π(3×5 + 6×10) = 75π

Given ratio = 4 : 1 ⇒ 24πr : 75π = 4 : 1

⇒ 24r / 75 = 4 ⇒ 24r = 300 ⇒ r = 12.5

⇒ 2r = 25

**∴ Answer = 25**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Height of cylinder = 12 cm, radius = r

Two cones: (r₁ = 3, h₁ = 4) and (r₂ = 6, h₂ = 8)

**Formula used:**

CSA of cylinder = 2πrh

CSA of cone = πrl

**Calculation:**

⇒ CSA of cylinder = 2πr × 12 = 24πr

⇒ Slant height of cone 1 = √(3² + 4²) = 5

⇒ CSA₁ = π × 3 × 5 = 15π

⇒ Slant height of cone 2 = √(6² + 8²) = 10

⇒ CSA₂ = π × 6 × 10 = 60π

⇒ Total CSA of cones = 15π + 60π = 75π

⇒ Given ratio: 24πr : 75π = 4 : 1

⇒ 24r / 75 = 4

⇒ 24r = 300

⇒ r = 12.5

⇒ 2r = 25

**∴ The correct answer is 25.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

CSA Formulas

Cylinder = 2πrh, Cone = πrl

Slant Height

l = √(r² + h²)

Ratio Concept

Compare expressions and solve for variable

Key Insight

π cancels out in ratio problems
